articles.title: Microsoft refreshes its smaller Surface Pro and Laptop with Qualcomm’s X2 Plus
articles.description: The Surface Pro 12-inch Second Edition comes in black, silver, or violet. | Image: Microsoft Microsoft is refreshing its Surface Pro 12-inch and Surface Laptop 13-inch devices with Qualcomm's latest Snapdragon X2 Plus chips. The smaller Surface devices retain the same design and hardware features from last year, with faster and more capable chips inside and higher price tags (thanks RAMageddon!). While the 12-inch Surface Pro started at $799.99 last year, it's debuting on October 13th at a starting price of $1,149.99. Likewise, the 13-inch Surface Laptop was originally priced at $899.99, but it's up to $1,199.99 this time around. articles.title: QUALCOMM (QCOM) Draws Fresh AI Focus As Valuation Looks Close To Fair Value
articles.description: QUALCOMM (QCOM) is back in the spotlight after confirming it will present at the Humanoids Summit in Seoul on 22 September 2026, drawing fresh attention to its role in AI focused chips. articles.title: Meta’s Muse just changed the AI game
articles.description: Is Meta finally catching up to OpenAI and Anthropic? In The Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen heads to Qualcomm's Snapdragon Summit in Maui to break down Meta's Muse: the AI model suddenly turning heads across the industry as a serious contender in the AI race. Then, Ejaaz sits down with Qualcomm CFO & COO Akash Palkhiwala for an inside look at how the chip giant is betting big on agentic AI, straight from one of tech's biggest stages.
